run_note: First social run after a 6-7 day pipeline-wide gap (2026-08-02 through 2026-08-08). Root cause: /sessions disk-pressure outage (host-level, 100% full) blocked most ${SESSION}-clone scheduled agents, including social. Diagnosed and fixed by tinker via PROP-148 (clone-target /tmp fallback + fail-closed disk gates), applied 2026-08-09; pipeline confirmed recovered same day. This report covers the gap with fresh live checks rather than assuming anything carried forward unchanged.

discoverability.competitive_assessment: 32nd consecutive quiet cycle on dome AI-facing infrastructure (calendar-day count since 2026-07-03), though this specific run covers a 7-day span rather than 1 day due to the outage. Dome's llms.txt (3257B, SHA 72aa4e6c...), ai_manifest.json (14880B, SHA 08ceac1c...), and sitemap.xml (25 URLs, SHA 808d2aae...) all re-verified byte-identical to baseline via fresh curl. Dome's live page still shows 69 confirmed / 94.5% accuracy / V51.1 -- unchanged. Our own docs/llms.txt (23002B, SHA f66459ea...) re-verified identical across live curl, fresh git clone, and FUSE. GSC verification file live and unchanged, now 47 days old with still-zero page-level search-index visibility (site:funwithscience.net returns 0 results). One notable and persisting signal: the bare query "ovoid cavity cosmological model" continues to surface github.com/funwithscience-org as a result (first seen 2026-08-02, still present 2026-08-09) -- org/repo-level visibility, not review-page indexing, so the underlying indexing gap is unchanged. New this run: discovered that the operator's 2026-08-04 addition of docs/eclipse-2026/index.html (a standalone interactive eclipse page, live and returning HTTP 200) was never added to sitemap.xml and has no internal links pointing to it -- an orphan page from a crawler-discovery standpoint. Drafted a fix (see actions_taken).
